aina: Heads-up: sampleapp onboarding run shows a long tail when customers import ~200 docs. UI shows "processing" for ~30s before any embedding results appear.
mike: Any logs?
aina: Paste: 
[2026-03-24T09:12:01Z] INFO start import 200
[2026-03-24T09:12:01Z] INFO client:init tokens=0 capacity=20
[2026-03-24T09:12:01Z] WARN embed request 0 -> 429
[2026-03-24T09:12:02Z] INFO queued=45 backoff=1s
[2026-03-24T09:12:31Z] INFO first success

li: Looks like token-bucket initial state is empty + auth refresh bursts cause queueing. We should avoid zero initial tokens for dev/sampleapp.
mike: Agreed. For prod keep conservative but sampleapp can prefill and also do a single warm embed at startup. That avoids user-facing stall.
aina: Proposed change: sampleapp config devOnboard.prefill=5 and prewarm=true. Also add metric onboarding.ttfs (time-to-first-success).
support-bot: Created ticket RED-DEVEX-1250: sampleapp: prefill tokens + prewarm on dev mode (severity: medium).
devex-bot: Suggest adding note in quickstart: "If importing many items at once, lower concurrency or enable dev prefill to avoid initial stalls."
li: I'll prep a patch for JS and Go SDKs to support optimisticInitialTokens with default 0 in prod and 3 in dev. Add unit test that asserts first-success <= 10s with dev prefill.
mike: Also add small jitter to initial backoff to prevent thundering-herd when many clients boot simultaneously.
aina: Thanks — I'll follow up with PR link once ready.
